nodes.label: L-001: Confirm date before schedule advice
nodes.description: Confirm current date/time from user's screen or system before giving schedule advice

nodes.label: L-008: Compute deadlines from official dashboard
nodes.description: Never estimate; use official dashboard times for deadline calculations

nodes.label: L-018: Never cut functionality without captain's sign-off
nodes.description: Sequence into vertical slices instead; labels for unchecked content are honesty, not mocks
